text_ja:
オレ......　こんな高いところ
初めて登ったよ！
text_en_machine: I... I've never been up this high!
text_en: I... I've never climbed so high before!

text_ja:
ココから先は　ちょっとコワくて進めないから...
みんなは　慎重にね！
text_en_machine:
It's a little scary out there, so...
So be careful!
text_en:
I can't go any further, it's too scary...
You all, be careful!

text_ja:
こんにちはっ！
きみたち、　冒険は初めて？
text_en_machine:
Hello!
Are you guys new to this adventure?
text_en:
Hello!
Is this your first adventure?

text_ja:
旅の途中で　出会ったヒトに　話しかけると、
きっと　何かいいことが　起こるよ。
text_en_machine:
If you talk to people you meet
on your journey,
Something good will surely happen.
text_en:
If you talk to people you meet on your
journey, something good might happen!

text_ja:
......僕は　みんなと　お話しできたのが
　　　よかったこと　かな！
text_en_machine: ...I guess it was good that I got to talk to everyone!
text_en:
...I think the best part
was talking to all of you!

text_ja:
うわああ！
風が強すぎて　吹き飛ばされちゃう！
text_en_machine:
Oh, my gosh!
It's too windy. I'll get blown away!
text_en:
Wow!
The wind's so strong,
I might be blown away!

text_ja:
...いや、　もしかして　風に身を任せて
飛ばされちゃったほうが　楽しいかも！？
text_en_machine: ...But maybe it would be more fun to just let the wind blow you away!
text_en:
...Or maybe it’d be more fun
to just let the wind take me!

text_ja: こんにちは、　旅の方。
text_en_machine: Hello, Traveler.

text_ja: こんにちはっ！　きみは？
text_en_machine: Hello! Who are you?

text_ja:
僕は　依頼を受けて
このあたりの　調査をしているものです。
text_en_machine:
I am a commissioned researcher.
I am doing research in this area
at the request of the company.
text_en:
I was hired to investigate
around here.

text_ja:
近くに　宝箱があるという　噂を聞きましたが.....
一体どこに　あるんでしょうね？
text_en_machine:
I heard a rumor that
there is a treasure chest nearby. .....
I wonder where it is?
text_en:
I heard there's a treasure chest nearby...
I wonder where it could be?

text_ja:
...それにしても、こうして立ち止まってみると
なんだか　心が落ち着く場所ですね。
text_en_machine: ...But when I stop here, it's a really relaxing place.
text_en:
... This place feels so peaceful, 
stopping here somehow makes me calm.

text_ja:
この森、　不気味な生き物が多くて
なんだか　危険な香りがします......
text_en_machine:
There are so many creepy creatures
in this forest.
There is a dangerous scent in the air......
text_en:
This forest has so many creepy creatures,
it feels dangerous...

text_ja:
もしも　襲ってきたらと思うと......
ううっ、怖いです！
text_en_machine:
Just think what would happen
if they attacked me......
Ugh, I'm scared!
text_en:
If they attack us...
Ugh, I'm scared!

text_ja: ワタシ、　一回ココに来てみたかったの！
text_en_machine: I've always wanted to come here!
text_en: I’ve always wanted to come here!

text_ja:
念願の　キノコケーキ......！
いただきまーす！！
text_en_machine:
I've been longing for
a mushroom cake......!
Bon appétit!
text_en:
The long-awaited mushroom cake...
Yum, here I go!!

text_ja:
キノコケーキ、おいしい～！
あれっ、なんだか体の様子が......
text_en_machine:
Mushroom cake, yummy!
Hmm, something about my body seems a bit off......
text_en:
This mushroom cake is delicious~!
Wait, I feel a little weird...

text_ja: わわわっ！
text_en_machine: Wow!

text_ja:
体が大きくなっちゃった......
まあ、いいかっ！
text_en_machine:
I'm getting bigger......
Oh well!
text_en:
My body’s getting bigger...
Well, it's fine!

text_ja:
このあたりの水は　キレイな紫色だねぇ～
入ってみたら楽しいかな？
text_en_machine:
The water around here has
a beautiful purple color.
Would it be fun to go in?
text_en:
The water here is such a pretty purple...
I wonder if it's fun to jump in?

text_ja: 毒だよ？！
text_en_machine: It's poison, right?

text_ja:
そうなの！！？！
......おうち帰って、ねようっと！
text_en_machine:
Really?!?!
....Let's go home and sleep!
text_en:
Really?!
...I think I’ll just head home and rest!

text_ja:
このあたり　すっごく暑いね......
このままだと　体が溶けちゃいそう
text_en_machine:
It's been so hot around here......
I feel like I'm going to melt.
text_en:
It's been so hot around here......
I feel like I'm going to melt.

text_ja: なんじゃ？幼気な竜の子たちじゃのう…
text_en_machine: What is it? Young dragon cubs...

text_ja:
過酷な環境の中　此処までやってくるとは
さぞ大変だったじゃろう。
text_en_machine:
I can't believe you made it this far
in such a harsh environment.
It must have been very hard work.
text_en:
You've come all this way through
such a harsh environment,
it must've been tough journey.

text_ja:
安全な此の場所で、
わっちと共に　心ゆくまで休んでいくがよい。
text_en_machine:
In this place of safety,
rest with us to your heart's content.
text_en:
Rest here in safety,
take your time, and relax with me.

text_ja:
海だー！
しおかぜが　きもちいいねっ
text_en_machine:
It's the sea!
The sea breeze is so nice!
text_en:
Sea!
The salty breeze feels great!

text_ja:
このまま　水遊び
しちゃおうっかなぁ......？
text_en_machine: Should I just keep playing in the water...?
text_en: Maybe I should just play in the water...?

text_ja:
ゆったり　とんでたら
こんな　とおくまできちゃった......！
text_en_machine: I was flying leisurely, and I ended up coming this far...!
text_en:
I was flying slowly and
ended up this far!

text_ja: いそいで　かえらないと！
text_en_machine: I'd better hurry up and go!

text_ja: みんな　またね～～
text_en_machine: See you all soon!

text_ja:
今日は　冷え込むなぁ。
カゼひかないように　気を付けてね。
text_en_machine:
It's cold today.
Be careful not to catch a cold.
text_en:
Today’s cold...
Stay warm and don’t catch a cold!

text_ja:
私と　プレーンくんは　おなじ星から
やってきた　ケーキドラゴンよ。
text_en_machine:
Mr. Plain and I are both cake dragons
from the same planet.
text_en:
Plain and I are cake dragons
from the same planet.

text_ja:
もし　フィズくんたちが　私たちの星に
来ることがあれば...
text_en_machine:
If Mr. fiz and his friends ever come
to our planet...
text_en: If you ever come to our planet, Fiz...

text_ja: そのときは　みんなで　遊びたいわね！
text_en_machine: I hope we can all play together then!

text_ja:
やあ！　こんにちは。
君たちは　この列車に乗るのは　初めて？
text_en_machine:
Hi!　Hello.
Is this your first time on this train?
text_en:
Hey!
Is this your first time on this train?

text_ja:
実は俺、　
今日　初めて乗ってみたんだけど......
text_en_machine:
Actually me,
I rode it for the first time today......
text_en:
I actually just got on today
for the first time...

text_ja:
都会なのに　緑に囲まれながら
移動できるなんて　便利だなあ！
text_en_machine: It's so convenient to be able to move around while being surrounded by greenery even in the city!
text_en:
Even though it's a city,
it's nice being surrounded by greenery!

text_ja: （ちゃんと　役に立ってる......）
text_en_machine: (It's really useful...)

text_ja:
そこの店から　ウマソ～なニオイがするから
フラッと　入ってみたんだけどよ......
text_en_machine:
I could smell something delicious in there.
So I just walked in...

text_ja:
なんでかしらねェが
即　追い出されたぞ！！
text_en_machine: I don't know why, but I was kicked out straight away!
text_en:
I don’t know why, but
I was immediately kicked out!!

text_ja:
（コンピューターを使って
　ゲームを　作っている）
text_en_machine: (I use a computer to create games)
text_en:
(He is busy making games
on his computer.)

text_ja:
（......と思いきや　今は
　ネットサーフィンを　しているようだ）
text_en_machine:
(...I thought so, but it looks like 
I'm surfing the internet right now)
text_en:
(...... On closer inspection, 
he appears to be surfing the net.)

text_ja: ここまでたどりつくとは、面白い個体ですね？
text_en_machine: I'm surprised you got this far. You're a fascinating one, aren't you?
text_en: Interesting individual to have made it this far.

text_ja:
貴方達が　この先で　何を成すのか、
見届けさせてもらいましょう!
text_en_machine:
Let's see what you will accomplish
in the future,
We'll see what you can do!
text_en:
Let me see what you'll accomplish.
I’ll watch closely!

text_ja:
こんなにたくさん　ひとが来るなんて
めずらしいなぁ......。
text_en_machine:
I can't believe so many people came.
It's rare to see so many people...
text_en: It’s rare to see so many people coming here.

text_ja:
みんな　ここまで来るの　大変だったでしょ。
ボクのおなかの上で　寝かせてあげようか？
text_en_machine:
It must have been hard for you all
to get here. Do you want me
to let you sleep on my tummy?
text_en:
Everyone must’ve had a tough time
getting here.
Want to sleep on my belly?

text_ja:
えっ...！！
おなかの上なんて、そんな......！
text_en_machine:
Eh...!
On your tummy, that's such a...!
...Just kidding!

text_ja:
私の加護によって　あなたたちは
何度でも蘇ることが　できるのです。
text_en_machine:
With my blessing,
you can come back
to life again and again.
text_en:
Thanks to my blessing,
you are able to come back to life
as many times as you need.

text_ja:
だからといって　無理はせず、
作戦を立てて　勝負に挑むのですよ。
text_en_machine: But with that said, don't be reckless. Come up with a strategy and then take on the fight.
text_en:
But don’t push it,
plan your strategy before taking on
a challenge.

text_ja:
神サマのおかげで　何回死んでも
再挑戦できるってコトだな！
text_en_machine: Thanks to god, no matter how many times I die, I can always try again!
text_en:
So basically, even if we die, we can 
try again thanks to the god’s power!

text_ja:
私は　あなたたちを見守りながら
様々な加護を　与えています。
text_en_machine: I am watching over you and bestowing various blessings upon you.
text_en:
I am always watching over you, 
granting various forms of blessings.

text_ja:
例えば、身を守るための道具を
無限に　使えるようにしたり......
text_en_machine:
For example, tools for self-defense.
They can be used infinitely...
text_en:
For example, I’ve made it so you can 
use protective tools without limit...

text_ja:
えっ！　どこからか出てくる　ぼくの
ハンマーって　そういう事だったの.....！？
text_en_machine: What?! Is that why my hammer appeared out of nowhere...?
text_en:
Wait, so that hammer of mine that just 
pops outta nowhere...
That’s because of you!?

text_ja:
そうですね。　ほかの道具のほうが
良かったでしょうか？
text_en_machine: Yes. Would other tools have been better?
text_en:
Yes, indeed. Maybe other tools 
would have been better?

text_ja:
いや......　けっこう便利だから
気に入ってるよ......
text_en_machine: No, really... I'm quite fond of it because it's actually pretty handy...
text_en:
Nah... it's actually really useful, 
so I kinda like it...

text_ja:
オーブには　虹のように、
７種類の色が存在しています。
text_en_machine: Orbs come in seven different colors, like a rainbow.
text_en:
Orbs exist in seven different colors, 
much like a rainbow.

text_ja:
ドラゴンは　ひとつのオーブの力によって　生まれ
その色が　体に反映されるのです。
text_en_machine: Dragons are born from the power of a single orb, whose color is reflected on their bodies.
text_en:
Dragons are born from the power of
a single orb, and their body reflects
the color of that origin.

text_ja:
そして　その体には　同色のオーブを蓄え
守り抜ける力が　備わっているのです。
text_en_machine: And their bodies are endowed with the power to store and protect orbs of the same color.
text_en:
They also have the ability to store orbs
of the same color in their bodies
and to protect them.

text_ja:
つまり　むらさき色のオーブが
わたしの起源ってわけね
text_en_machine: So the purple orb is my origin.
text_en:
So... that means the purple 
orb is where I came from.

text_ja: タオンガって　ホントに神さまなのーー！？
text_en_machine: Are you really a god?
text_en: Taonga, are you really a god?

text_ja: ふふふ... どうでしょうか？
text_en_machine: Hmmm... What do you think?

text_ja:
だれかが神様だと思えば、
それはもう　神様なのかもしれませんね。
text_en_machine: If you think someone is god, then maybe they are god.
text_en:
If someone truly believes in a god... 
then perhaps, that belief makes it real.

text_ja: なにそれーーー！！！
text_en_machine: What the heck is that!

text_ja:
「立体保護区」には　必殺技が使えない
奇妙な空間が　広がっています。
text_en_machine: The '3D Protected Zone' is a strange space where special moves cannot be used.
text_en:
The Dimensional Sanctuary’s a strange
place...
and Special Moves won’t work here.

text_ja:
同じ方向に進み続けているのに、気づけば
振り出しにもどってしまうことも　しばしば。
text_en_machine: Even though we keep moving in the same direction, we often find ourselves back at square one.
text_en:
Even if you keep going in the same 
direction, you might end up back
where you started.

text_ja:
しかし、空間の特性を利用できれば
難なく　突破することができるでしょう。
text_en_machine: However, if you can utilize the properties of space, you will be able to break through it with ease.
text_en:
But if you use the space’s traits
to your advantage, you can make it
through without much trouble.

text_ja:
リーファーの矢も　そこで
使いこなせるように　なりたいな...
text_en_machine: I hope I can learn to master my arrows there, too...
text_en:
I wanna get better at using
Leafur’s arrows in there...

text_ja:
ドラゴンによって　得意な状況と
そうでない状況は　異なるようです。
text_en_machine: Dragons seem to have different situations in which they excel and those in which they do not.
text_en:
Each Dragon is strong in some stages, 
but struggles in others too.

text_ja:
状況を見極め、協力し合って
ステージを突破していきたいものです。
text_en_machine: We need to assess the situation, work together, and get through the stages.
text_en:
Let’s keep a sharp eye out and team up 
to clear every Stage together.

text_ja:
水の中は　泳ぎがイチバン速い　俺の
独壇場ってワケだ。　なあ？リュトロン？
text_en_machine:
I'm the fastest swimmer in the water.
Right, Rythron?
text_en:
Underwater's my territory,
I'm the fastest swimmer here.
Right, Rythron?

text_en_machine: Damn... This guy...

text_ja:
おや......　繰り返し感電して
命を　落としているようですね。
text_en_machine: Oh... it seems you are repeatedly getting electrocuted and losing your life.
text_en:
Uh-oh... You got shocked again. 
That’s another LIFE gone.

text_ja:
電撃は　一度だけでも命取りです。
細心の注意を　払いましょう。
text_en_machine:
Even a single electric shock can be fatal.
Be extremely careful.
text_en:
One jolt is all it takes...
Be extra careful around
those zappy spots.

text_ja:
おや......　何度も炎に焼かれ
命を　落としているようですね。
text_en_machine: Oh... It seems that you have been burned by fire many times and lost your life.
text_en:
Oh... That fire’s burned you
again and again... and again...

text_ja:
火炎に晒され続け
平気でいられる体など　存在しません。
text_en_machine: No body can be exposed to flames for long periods of time and still remain calm.
text_en:
No one can stand in flames forever. 
You’ve gotta be more careful.

text_ja:
決して　燃え盛る炎に入ろうなどと
考えては　いけませんよ。
text_en_machine: Never think about stepping into a blazing fire.
text_en:
Don’t even think about
diving into those flames, okay?

text_ja:
おや......　何度も力を奪われ
石にされてしまった　ようですね......。
text_en_machine: Oh... It seems you have been drained of power multiple times and turned to stone...
text_en:
Oof... Turned to stone again?
That’s not a good look...

text_ja:
奴の光線は　非常に危険です。
直接浴びないよう　慎重に進みましょう。
text_en_machine:
That thing's beam is extremely dangerous.
Proceed with caution to avoid direct exposure.
text_en:
That light beam is super dangerous.
Try not to get hit directly.

text_ja:
なんども　捕食者に
飲み込まれているようですが.....
text_en_machine: It appears you're getting swallowed by predators over and over...
text_en:
Uhhh... You’ve been eaten
by the predator. Again...

text_ja:
快楽を求め　自ら飛び込んで
いるのでは　ないですよね？
text_en_machine: You're not jumping into it for pleasure, are you?
text_en:
Wait... you’re not jumping into 
its mouth on purpose, are you...?

text_ja:
...そんなに　捕食されることが
とりこになるようなことなのですか？
text_en_machine: ...Is being preyed upon so enthralling?
text_en: ...Is it really that fun getting eaten!?

text_ja: 私も今度　試してみましょうか。
text_en_machine: I'll give it a try sometime.
text_en: Maybe I should give it a try next time...

text_ja: えっ
text_en_machine: What's up?

text_ja:
まだ見ぬ快楽が　この世に存在するならば、
ぜひこの身で　体験してみたいものですね。
text_en_machine:
If there is a pleasure in this world that I have not yet seen,
I would like to experience it for myself.
text_en:
If there’s a pleasure
I haven’t felt in this world...
I wanna feel it!

text_ja:
からだおおきいから
食べられないんじゃない？
text_en_machine: Aren't you too large to be eaten?
text_en:
Maybe you’re just too big
to get eaten?

text_ja:
体の大きさなど、私にとっては　魔法で
思いのままにできる　ささいなことです。
text_en_machine: Regarding body size, it's a trivial matter for me, as I can manipulate it with magic as I wish.
text_en:
Size means nothing to me.
Magic can fix that easily.

text_ja: （神さま　変なスイッチ入っちゃった...）
text_en_machine: （The god's...acting weird now...)
text_en: (Oh no... We flipped a weird switch...)

text_ja:
なんども　水に溺れて
命を　落としているようですね。
text_en_machine:
You've drowned in the water so many times.
It seems you have lost your life.
text_en:
You’ve drowned again.
That water’s no joke.

text_ja:
泳ぐことが苦手な　仲間を、
無理に　泳がせてはなりませんよ。
text_en_machine: If a friend is not good at swimming, don't force them to swim.
text_en:
Don’t force someone to swim
if they’re not good at it, okay?

text_ja:
宇宙のどこかにある星　惑星ロンガ。         
ある日、この星で暮らす　こどものドラゴン
「<color=#55FFFFFF>フィズ</color>」は夢を見ました。
text_en_machine:
Somewhere in the universe is the planet Longa.
One day, a child dragon
<color=#55FFFFFFF>Fiz</color>, who lives on this planet, had a dream.
text_en:
Somewhere in space lies Planet Longa.
One day, a young dragon named 
<color=#55FFFFFF>Fiz</color> had a dream.

text_ja:
その夢は　世界がモノクロになり
全ての生き物が　動かなくなってしまうという
恐ろしい悪夢です。
text_en_machine: The dream is a horrifying nightmare in which the world becomes monochrome and all living things stop moving.
text_en:
In the dream, the world went gray...
All life froze in place...
A terrifying nightmare.

text_ja:
目を覚ました<color=#55FFFFFF>フィズ</color>は、夢の内容が未来に
起こりうることだと、目の前に現れた
全知全能のドラゴン「<color=#FBF97AFF>タオンガ</color>」から告げられます。
text_en_machine: When <color=#55FFFFFF>Fizz</color> wakes up, the all-knowing and all-powerful dragon <color=#FBF97AFF>Taonga</color> appears before him and tells him that the content of his dream is something that could happen in the future.
text_en:
Awake, <color=#55FFFFFF>Fiz</color> learned his dream
might come true,
Taonga, the all-knowing dragon, warned.

text_ja:
そして、未来を変えるには　七匹のドラゴンが
力を合わせて　世界に散らばるオーブを
守らなければならない　というのです。
text_en_machine: And to change the future, the seven dragons must join forces to protect the orbs scattered around the world.
text_en:
To change that future, seven dragons
must unite to guard the scattered
Orbs across the world.

text_ja:
それを聞いて　決意した<color=#55FFFFFF>フィズ</color>は、
世界を守るため、
仲間を探す冒険へと　出発するのでした...。
text_en_machine:
Hearing this, <color=#55FFFFFFF>Fiz</color> made up his mind
and set off on an adventure to find his companions,
to protect the world...
text_en:
Hearing this, <color=#55FFFFFF>Fiz</color> vowed
to protect the world,
and set off to find allies......

text_ja: わっ！
text_en_machine: Wow!

text_ja:
ソラコだよっ
よろしくね！
text_en_machine:
I'm Soraco!
Nice to meet you!
text_en:
I’m Soraco!
Nice to meet you!

text_ja:
わーい！
やっと　そとに出られた！
text_en_machine:
Yay!
I'm finally out!

text_ja:
穴に落ちた時は　この先
どうなることかと　思ったよ……！
text_en_machine: When I fell into the hole, I wondered what would happen to me...!
text_en:
When I fell down that hole,
I wondered what would happen!

text_ja:
ところで　ここはどこなんだろう？
森の中　みたいだけど……
text_en_machine:

フィズたちは、伝書竜から
「<color=#ee7800FF>プレーンからの手紙</color>」を受け取った！

ここは　オイラがくらしてる　さばくなんだ！
いっしょに　ぼうけんしよう！
text_en_machine: This is the desert where I live! Let's go on an adventure together!
text_en:
This desert’s my home!
Come on, let’s adventure here!

text_ja:
流砂だ！
中に沈まないように　気をつけなきゃ
text_en_machine: Quicksand! I need to be careful not to sink in!
text_en:
Quicksand ahead!
Watch your step or you’ll sink!

text_ja:
このあたりは　かぜがつよいから
きをつけて　すすもうね……！
text_en_machine: The wind is strong around here, so let's proceed with caution...!
text_en:
The wind’s strong here...
Let’s move carefully!

text_ja: あっ　あんなところにコインが！
text_en_machine: Oh, there's a coin over there!
text_en:
Hey, look!
A Coin over there.

text_ja:
りゅうさの中に　こんなばしょがあったなんて！
オイラ　しらなかった……
text_en_machine: I didn't know there was a place like this in the quicksand!
text_en:
I never knew the quicksand
hid a place like this!

text_ja:
砂でできた　高いカベが　あって
進めなさそうだね…
text_en_machine: There's a high wall made of sand, so it looks like we can't get through...
text_en:
There’s a tall sand wall...
we can’t get through here...

text_ja: だいじょうぶ！　オイラにまかせて！
text_en_machine: No problem! Leave it to me!
text_en: No worries! Leave it to me!

text_ja:
オイラの　ひっかきこうげきで
どんなあなでも　あけちゃうよっ！
text_en_machine: With my scratching attack, I can open any hole!
text_en:
With my claw strike,
I can burrow through any hole!

text_ja:
わっ　みずが　たくさんある…
オイラ　およぐのは　ニガテなんだ…
text_en_machine: Wow, there's so much water... I'm not good at swimming...
text_en:
Whoa, so much water...
I’m not the best swimmer...

text_ja:
ドラゴンには　得意不得意が　ありますから、
しっかりと　力を合わせて　進みましょう。
text_en_machine: Dragons have their strengths and weaknesses, so let's work together and move forward.
text_en:
Every Dragon has strengths
and weaknesses. Let’s team up!

text_ja: （こおどりしている）
text_en_machine: (Dancing)

text_ja:
すごい......　砂漠の真ん中に
こんなところが　あるなんて！
text_en_machine: Amazing... I can't believe there's a place like this in the middle of the desert!
text_en:
Amazing... a spot like this
in the middle of a desert!

text_ja:
すごいでしょ！
オイラいつも　ここで釣りしてるんだ～
text_en_machine: Isn't it great? I always fish here!
text_en:
Isn’t it awesome?
I fish here all the time~

text_ja:
あっ　きをつけて！　ビリビリにさわると
しびれて　ふき飛ばされちゃうよ！
text_en_machine: Oh, be careful! If you touch it, you'll get shocked and blown away!
text_en:
Watch out! Touch those zappers
and you’ll get shocked away!

text_ja:
（オイラは　しびれにくい　からだだから
　けっこう　ガマンできるけど......）
text_en_machine: (I can endure it because I have a body that doesn't get paralyzed...)
text_en:
(I’m pretty shock-resistant,
so I can handle it...)

text_ja:
通り道が 前後に動いてる！
手前と奥、どっちにも進めそうだね
text_en_machine: The path is moving back and forth! It looks like we can go both forward and backward.
text_en:
This path moves back and forth!
Both sides look passable!

text_ja: こっちは　いきどまりみたい......
text_en_machine: This side seems to be a dead end...
text_en: This way seems like a dead end...

text_ja: うわあーっ！
text_en_machine: Whoa!

text_ja: 落ちるーー！！！
text_en_machine: I'm falling!!!

text_ja:
いてて......                     
っここは！？
text_en_machine: Ouch... Where am I!?

text_ja:
わぁ～！　キラキラしてる！
キレイな　どうくつだねぇ～！
text_en_machine: Wow~! It's sparkling! What a beautiful cave!
text_en:
Wow~! It’s sparkling!
What a beautiful cave~!

text_ja:
うわわっ　なにあれ！
こっちに　むかってくるよ！
text_en_machine: Whoa, what's that? It's coming this way!
text_en:
Whoa, what’s that!
It’s coming right at us!

text_ja:
危ない！　カプセルみたいな
弾が　どんどん飛んでくるよ！
text_en_machine: Danger! Capsules are flying at us one after another!
text_en:
Danger! Capsule-like shots
are flying our way!

text_ja:
なんとかして　操縦してるターボンを
止めないと......！
text_en_machine: We have to stop the Tabon that's controlling them somehow...!
text_en:
We need to stop the Tabon
piloting it...!

text_ja:
飛んでくる弾を　跳ね返して
攻撃に使えないかな......？
text_en_machine: Can we bounce back the flying bullets and use them for our attack...?
text_en:
Could we deflect those shots
and use them to attack...?

text_ja:
オイラなら　ひっかき攻撃で
はねかえせるかも......!
text_en_machine: I might be able to bounce them back with my scratching attack...!
text_en:
I think a claw strike
could send them back...!

text_ja:
このターボン...　ヘルメットを被ってるから
上からの攻撃が　効かないかも......？
text_en_machine: This Tabon... It's wearing a helmet, so attacks from above might not work...?
text_en:
That Tabon’s wearing a helmet...
stomps might not work...?

text_ja:
窓が割れた！
これで　中に入れそう......！
text_en_machine: The window broke! Now we can probably get inside...!
text_en:
The window’s broken!
Now we can get inside!

text_ja: やった！止まった！
text_en_machine: Yay! It stopped!

text_ja: オーブ　みつけた！
text_en_machine: I found an Orb!

text_ja:
ここクッキー砂漠には、その名の通り
オレンジ色のオーブが　存在します。
text_en_machine: Here in Cookie Sands, as the name suggests, there exists an orange Orb.
text_en:
In Cookie Sands, as its name
suggests, bright orange Orbs appear.

text_ja:
見たことあるかも！　オイラとおなじ色の
オーブがあるんだねぇ～
text_en_machine: I might have seen it before! There's an Orb that's the same color as me~.
text_en:
I might have seen it before!
It’s the same color as me~

text_ja:
そうです。そして　オーブの力を蓄えることが
できるのは　同じ色のドラゴンだけ...
text_en_machine: That's right. And only dragons of the same color can store the power of the Orb...
text_en:
Indeed.  Only a Dragon of the same 
color can hold an Orb’s power...

text_ja:
つまり　ソラコ、あなたがクッキー砂漠の
オーブを　守らねばなりません。
text_en_machine: In other words, Soraco, you must protect the Orb in Cookie Sands.
text_en:
So, Soraco, you must guard
Cookie Sands’ Orbs.

text_ja: はわわ......　がんばらなきゃ......
text_en_machine: Ahhh... I have to try harder...
text_en: Oh... I really need to do my best...

text_ja:
あたり一面砂漠の　クッキー砂漠ですが、
奥には　広大なオアシスがあります。
text_en_machine: The orange desert is all around, but deep inside lies a vast oasis.
text_en:
Although Cookie Sands is all desert,
a vast oasis lies deep within.

text_ja:
そこの真下には　どうやらオーブの力が
集まる洞窟が　あるようです。
text_en_machine: Right beneath it, there seems to be a cave where the power of Orbs gathers.
text_en:
Beneath it is a cave
where Orb power gathers.

text_ja:
ターボンたちは　そのような場所を
狙っているかも　しれませんね。
text_en_machine: Tabons might be targeting such places.
text_en:
Tabon might be targeting 
places like that.

text_ja:
この森から出るには、イチバン深いところにある
大きな葉っぱを　目指すといいよ！
text_en_machine: To get out of this forest, aim for the big leaf that's deepest inside!
text_en:
To leave this forest, head
for the giant leaf at its heart!

text_ja:
うっ……
足場が遠くて　のぼれない……
text_en_machine: Ugh... The footholds are too far apart to climb...
text_en:
Ugh... these ledges are too
far apart... I can’t climb...

text_ja: ここは　リーファーにまかせて！
text_en_machine: Leave this to Leafur!
text_en:
This is Leafur’s domain,
leave it to me!

text_ja:
リーファーの はばたきで、このくらいの距離なら
飛び越えられるよ！
text_en_machine: With Leafur's flapping, I can jump over distances like this!
text_en:
With Leafur’s flutter,
I can clear this gap!

text_ja:
わ！　ビリビリがいっぱい......
こわいなあ
text_en_machine: Wow! There are so many shocks... This is scary.
text_en:
Whoa! So many zappers...
This is scary!

text_ja: こういうところもリーファーの出番だよ！
text_en_machine: This is also Leafur's chance to shine!
text_en: This is also Leafur’s time to shine!

text_ja:
細い隙間を　潜り抜けるように
滑空できるんだ～！
text_en_machine: I can glide through narrow gaps like this~!
text_en: I can glide through narrow gaps!

text_ja: こっち側は　行き止まりみたいだね
text_en_machine: This side seems to be a dead end.
text_en: This side seems to be a dead end.

text_ja: むこうのほうに　スイッチが見えるね！
text_en_machine: I see a switch over there!
text_en: I see a switch over there!

text_ja:
リーファーの矢を使えば、
あそこのスイッチも　押せるよ！
text_en_machine: If I use Leafur's arrow, I can press that switch too!
text_en:
With Leafur’s arrows,
I can press that switch!

text_ja: ここからは　リーファーの　森だよー！
text_en_machine: From here on is Leafur's forest!
text_en: From here on, it’s Leafur’s forest!

text_ja: この木箱は　押して　動かせるよ！
text_en_machine: You can push and move this wooden box!
text_en: You can push that crate to move it!

text_ja: おおきい　きばこだねー！
text_en_machine: That's a big box!

text_ja: 何が入っているんだろう…？
text_en_machine: I wonder what's inside...?

text_ja: おれの炎で　よく燃えそうだな！
text_en_machine: My flames should burn it well!
text_en:
With my flames, I can
burn it to ashes!

text_ja: あ！　きばこで　みちが　ふさがってるよ！？
text_en_machine: Oh no! The treasure box is blocking the way!?
text_en: Ah! That crate is blocking the path!?

text_ja:
斜めのスキマから　リーファーの矢を使えば
通れるように　なるかも…？
text_en_machine: If I use Leafur's arrow from the diagonal gap, maybe we can get through...?
text_en:
If I shoot an arrow through that gap,
maybe we’ll clear a path!

text_ja:
僕の必殺技で　壁の向こうの　敵を倒せば
通れるように　なるかも…？
text_en_machine: If I defeat the enemy on the other side of the wall with my special move, maybe we can pass...?
text_en:
If I use my Special Move on those enemies,
we might squeeze on through...?

text_ja: やったあ！　とおれたね！
text_en_machine: Yay! We made it through!

text_ja:
おれの炎の力なら
このくらい　朝飯前だぜ！
text_en_machine: With my flame power, this is just a piece of cake for me!
text_en:
With my flame power,
this is a piece of cake!

text_ja: うわっ！　なにあれ！？
text_en_machine: Whoa! What's that!?

text_ja:
あのくねくねの近くを　ゆっくり通ると
たべられちゃうよ！　きをつけて……！
text_en_machine: If you pass slowly near that squiggly thing, you'll get eaten! Be careful...!
text_en:
Those wriggly things will
snap you up if you get too close!
Be careful!

text_ja: オーブ見つけた！
text_en_machine: I found an Orb! It's a beautiful green color~!

text_ja: キレイな緑色～！
text_en_machine: It's a beautiful green color!

text_ja:
この辺りは　地形が複雑だから、
敵に　気を付けて　進もうね...！
text_en_machine: This area has complex terrain, so let's be careful of enemies as we proceed...!
text_en:
This terrain’s tricky,
keep an eye out for foes!

text_ja:
飲み込まれたと思ったら
こんなところに　コインが...！
text_en_machine: When I thought I'd been swallowed, there was a coin here...!
text_en:
I thought I was eaten...
but there’s a Coin!

text_ja:
毎回こんなだったら
わざと食べられても　いいかもね！
text_en_machine: If it were always like this, it might be okay to get eaten on purpose sometimes!
text_en:
If every time was this fun,
being eaten wouldn’t be so bad!

text_ja:
何を言うのです。うっかり命を落とせば
目も当てられませんよ？
text_en_machine: What are you saying? If you carelessly lose your life, you won't even want to look at it?
text_en:
Beware, young dragons.
One careless moment could 
end your story forever.

text_ja: （ぎくっ）
text_en_machine: (Gulp)

text_ja:
なになに！！？
白いやつが　追っかけてくる！
text_en_machine:
What?!
The white one is chasing me!
text_en:
Wait, what!? That white creature
is chasing us!

text_ja: 助けて～！！
text_en_machine: Help!!

text_ja:
大丈夫だよ！背中を向けなければ
その場で止まって　追ってこないから......！
text_en_machine: It's okay! If you don't turn your back on it, it'll stop right there and won't chase you...!
text_en:
Don’t worry. Face it,
and it won’t chase you!

text_ja: ここは　毒の湖だよ！
text_en_machine: This is a poisonous lake!

text_ja:
ほとんどのドラゴンは　少し触れるだけでも
死んじゃうから　落ちないようにしようね...！
text_en_machine: Most dragons die just from touching it a little bit, so let's avoid falling in...!
text_en:
Most Dragons die with one touch,
don’t let yourself fall in!

text_ja: スイッチと...　細い隙間が　あるね
text_en_machine: There's a switch and... a narrow gap.
text_en: I see a switch...and a narrow gap here.

text_ja:
不思議な空間だけど、リーファーの矢
届くかな？
text_en_machine: It's a mysterious space; I wonder if Leafur's arrow will reach?
text_en:
This place is strange.
Can Leafur’s arrow reach it?

text_ja:
今度は　壁の向こうに　スイッチが！
どうやったら　押せるんだろう？
text_en_machine: Now there's a switch on the other side of the wall! How can we press it?
text_en:
Now the switch’s behind that wall!
How do we hit it?

text_en_machine: Oh no, what is that...?

text_ja:
あの白い生物は　『モスターボン』...
空中を飛び回り　獲物を惑わせるといいます。
text_en_machine: That white creature is called ""Mostabon""... It flies around in the air and confuses its prey.
text_en:
That white creature is Mothtabon.
It flies to confuse its prey.

text_ja:
このままじゃ　リーファー達もろとも
大きな葉っぱを　食い荒らされちゃうよ！
text_en_machine: At this rate, even Leafur and friends will devour those big leaves completely!
text_en:
At this rate, it’ll eat us
and the giant leaf too!

text_ja:
空中を飛び回るのなら、飛び道具を使える
僕たちで　何とかしなきゃ！
text_en_machine: If it's flying around in the air, we must do something with our projectile weapons!
text_en:
If it can fly around, we’ll 
need to use ranged attacks!

text_ja: ぎゃっ！いっぱいでてきた！
text_en_machine: Yikes! So many are coming out!
text_en: Eek! There are so many of them!

text_ja:
ちいさい方は　リーファーの矢の力で
まとめて　やっつけちゃえ......！
text_en_machine: The smaller ones can be defeated all at once with Leafur's arrows...!
text_en:
Take out all the little ones at once
with Leafur’s arrow!

text_ja: オーブが　落ちてきたよ！
text_en_machine: An Orb fell down!

text_ja:
大きな葉っぱで森を抜けて、オーブも見つけた！
一件落着だね！
text_en_machine:
We got through the forest with the big leaves and found an Orb!
Everything's settled now!
text_en:
We rode the Giant Leaf out of the forest
and secured an Orb!
Case closed!

text_ja:
この森には　ドラゴンをも捕食してしまう
恐ろしい生き物が　住んでいるようです。
text_en_machine: It seems that this forest is inhabited by terrifying creatures that even prey on dragons.
text_en:
They say this forest is home to
terrifying beasts that even
devour dragons.

text_ja:
くれぐれも　飲み込まれないよう
気を付けてくださいね。
text_en_machine: Please be careful not to get swallowed.
text_en: Be very careful not to get eaten!

text_ja:
心配しないで　神さま！
大丈夫だよっ！
text_en_machine:
Don't worry about me, god!
I'll be fine!
text_en:
Don’t worry, Taonga.
I can handle it!

text_ja:
「大きな葉っぱ」... そう呼ばれる植物が
ここマッチャ樹海には　自生しています。
text_en_machine: The plant called ""Giant Leaf"" grows naturally in this Matcha Forrest.
text_en:
Here in the Matcha Forest, the plant
called “Giant Leaf” grows wild.

text_ja:
成長し続ける　双葉に乗ることで、この樹海から
抜け出すことが　できるようです。
text_en_machine: By riding on its continuously growing leaves, we seem to be able to escape from this jungle.
text_en:
By riding its ever-growing twin leaves,
we can break free from the jungle.

text_ja:
ぼくは　準備万端だから、
いつでも　勝負できるよ！
text_en_machine: I'm fully prepared, so I'm ready for battle anytime!
text_en:
I’m fully prepared.
Challenge me whenever you like!

text_ja:
きみの　心の準備ができたら
奥にある扉の先へ　進んでね！
text_en_machine: When you're ready, go through the door at the back!
text_en:
When your heart is ready,
step through the door at the back!

text_ja:
さっきは惜しかったね......！次はぼくに
一度も飲み込まれずに　勝てるかな？
text_en_machine: You were so close last time...! Next time, can you win without getting swallowed by me once?
text_en:
That was close...! Next time,
can you win without letting me
swallow you?

text_ja:
もうプレゼントは　あげちゃったけど、
また戦ってくれるなら　大歓迎だよ！
text_en_machine: I've already given you your present, but you'd be more than welcome to fight again!
text_en:
I’ve already given you a gift,
but if you want another round,
I’d be delighted!

text_ja: （もうちょっと味わってみたいし......）
text_en_machine: (I want to taste it a bit more...)

text_ja: それじゃあ、いくよっ！
text_en_machine: Well then, let's go!

text_ja:
............                                    
ざんねん！今回はぼくに捕まっちゃったね。
text_en_machine:
...
Too bad! You got caught by me this time.
text_en:
...
Too bad! I caught you this time.

text_ja: 諦めずに　また挑戦してよ！
text_en_machine: Don't give up. Try again!

text_ja:
............                                    
ざんねん！今回はぼくの勝ちだったね。
text_en_machine:
...
Too bad! I won this time, didn't I?

text_ja: 諦めずに　また挑戦してよ！
text_en_machine: Don't give up. Try again!

text_ja:
............                                    
きみたちスゴイよ！ぼくの完敗だったね...！
text_en_machine:
...
You guys are amazing! You totally defeated me...!
text_en:
...You guys are amazing!
I’m totally defeated...!

text_ja: またこんど勝負しようね！
text_en_machine: Let's play again next time!

text_ja:
............                                    
きみたちスゴイよ！ぼくの完敗だったね...！
text_en_machine:
...
You guys are amazing! You totally defeated me...!

text_ja: 約束通り、いいものをプレゼントするよ！
text_en_machine: As promised, I'll give you something good!
text_en:
As promised,
I have a special gift for you!

text_ja: フィズたちは、「<color=#FF3333FF>招待券</color>」を手に入れた！
text_en_machine: Fiz and his team got ""<color=#FF3333FF>invitation card</color>""!
text_en:
Fiz and his friends received
an <color=#FF3333FF>Invitation Card</color>!

text_ja: これ、何の招待券？
text_en_machine: What are these invitations for?

text_ja:
これは、ぼくがこの星で探している
ケーキ屋さんの招待券なんだ！
text_en_machine: This is the invitation to the cake shop I'm looking for on this planet!
text_en:
It’s to the cake shop I’ve
been seeking on this planet!

text_ja:
何枚か余ってたから、
きみたちにも　ぜひ使ってほしいな！
text_en_machine:
I have a few left over,
so I hope you'll use them too!
text_en: I had a few extras, please use one too!

text_ja: やったー！　ありがとうプレーンくん！
text_en_machine: Thank you, Mr. Plain!

text_ja:
この星は　自然が豊かで
本当にいいところだね......！
text_en_machine: This planet is rich in nature and is a truly wonderful place!
text_en:
This planet is so rich in nature,
what a wonderful place!

text_ja:
こんにちは！　ぼくはプレーン。
少し離れた星からやってきた　ドラゴンだよ。
text_en_machine: Hello! I'm Plain, a dragon from a planet a little far away.
text_en:
Hello! I’m Plain,
a dragon from a planet far away.

text_ja:
準備ができたら　扉に入ってね。
楽しみに　待ってるよ......！
text_en_machine:
When you're ready, come through the door.
I'll be waiting for you...
text_en:
When you’re ready, step through.
I’ll be waiting...!

text_ja:
プレーンくん　こんにちは！
ここで　何をしてるのっ？
text_en_machine:
Hello, Mr. Plain!
What are you doing here?
text_en: Hi, Plain! What brings you here?

text_ja:
この星に　おいしいケーキがないかを
探しに来たんだけど......　迷っちゃった。
text_en_machine: I came to this planet to find some delicious cakes, but... I got lost.
text_en:
I came looking for delicious cakes,
but got lost instead...

text_ja:
あらら...
このあたりは　すぐ迷っちゃうよね......
text_en_machine:
Oops...
It's easy to get lost around here...

Oops... 
It’s easy to get lost here...

ところで　きみたちのからだ、すごく......
いや......　なんでもない。
text_en_machine:
By the way, your bodies are really...

text_en:
By the way, your bodies look so yum...
uh, never mind.

text_en: ...Hey! Wanna challenge me to a duel?

text_ja:
一度もぼくに　捕まらずに勝てたら、
なにかいいものを　プレゼントするよ！
text_en_machine: If you can win without getting caught by me even once, I'll give you something great as a gift!
text_en:
If you can beat me without getting
caught once, I’ll give you a special gift!

text_ja:
プレゼント！？
ほしい～！！
text_en_machine:
A present!
I want it!

text_ja:
場所は　右側の扉を入った先にある
空間にしようかな。
text_en_machine: I think the location will be the space just inside the door on the right.
text_en:
Let’s set our match in the room
inside the door on the right.

text_ja:
ぼくの思ったとおり、
やっぱりキミたち　いい味ついてたよ！
text_en_machine:
Just as I thought,
you guys are really tasty!
text_en:
Just as I thought, 
you all taste amazing!

text_en:
Especially you, Fiz... 
that cool texture and light, 
refreshing sweetness...

you guys are really tasty!

味わうほどに　海の良いだしが出てきて.....
text_en_machine: Especially Mr. Kyuma... a bit salty, but the more you taste it, the more the delicious flavor of the sea comes out...
text_en:
Especially Kyuma... a little salty,
but so full of rich sea flavor...

text_en_machine: Ugh...!

text_ja:

やっぱりキミたち　いい味ついてたよ！
text_en_machine:
Just as I thought,
you guys are really tasty!
text_en:
Just as I thought, 
you all taste amazing!

text_ja:
特にリーファーちゃんはね...　控えめな甘さで
お茶の葉のうまみが　あって......
text_en_machine: Especially Leafur... a subtle sweetness and the delicious flavor of the tea leaves...
text_en:
Especially you, Leafur... 
gentle sweetness with the 
tea leaf’s delicious flavor...

text_ja: きゃーっ　言わないでー！！！
text_en_machine: Aaahh don't say that!!!

text_ja:

やっぱりキミたち　いい味ついてたよ！

you guys are really tasty!

text_en_machine:
Especially little Rubell...　Sweet like candy.

Especially you, Rubell... 
candy-like sweetness
with a tangy hint of spice...

text_ja: ぅぅぅ...！恥ずかしい...！
text_en_machine: Uuuuh...! How embarrassing...!

やっぱりキミたち　いい味ついてたよ！
text_en_machine:
Just as I thought,

Just as I thought,
you guys are really tasty!

text_en_machine: Especially Mr. Rythron... with his rich sweetness and red and white body, he looks just like a strawberry...
text_en:
Especially Rythron... 
rich sweetness and red-and-white 
stripes, just like a strawberry mochi...

はぁッ！！？　おい！　おれがそんなッ

text_en_machine: Huh?! Hey! There's no way I taste that...cute!!
text_en:
What!? Hey! I don’t...
There's no way I taste that...cute!!

やっぱりキミたち　いい味ついてたよ！
text_en_machine:
Just as I thought,
you guys are really tasty!

Just as I thought, 
you all taste amazing!

text_ja:

もちもちおなかのバランスが　絶妙で......
text_en_machine: Especially you, Soraco... he has the perfect balance between smooth skin and soft belly...
text_en:
Especially you, Soraco...
silky skin and a chewy belly,
perfect balance...

text_en_machine: Whoa, stop it!!!

ようこそ！
ここはおれの住処、ベリー火山だ！
text_en_machine:
Welcome!
This is where I live, Berry Volcano!
text_en:
Welcome! This is my home.
The mighty Berry Volcano!

text_ja:
こんな崖、おれにとっては
どうってことないぜ！
text_en_machine: A cliff like this is no big deal to me!
text_en:
Cliffs like these?
Not a problem for me!

text_ja: リュトロンくんって、すごい～～！！
text_en_machine: Rythron is amazing!

text_ja: げえっ！水だ...!
text_en_machine: Geez! Water...!

text_ja:
おれは水がその...　苦手だから、
絶対に　触れないように　してくれよな？！
text_en_machine: I'm not good with water, so please make sure I don't touch it!
text_en:
I’m terrible at swimming, 
so keep me away from it!

text_ja:
リュトロンくんも　そうなんだ！
オイラと　いっしょだねっ！
text_en_machine:
Oh, yeah, that's right, Mr. Rythron!
It's just like me, isn't it?

text_ja: うゎぇ！　こんなところにもいるのぉ！？
text_en_machine: Wow! You're here too in a place like this?!

text_ja:
しかもこんなに狭いところ...
絶対　とおれないよ...！
text_en_machine: And it's so narrow...there's no way I could get through!
text_en:
This gap’s way too narrow...
There’s no way I can get through!

text_ja:
オマエら！　こんなのしょせん草だ！
おれが横から　燃やしてやるよ！
text_en_machine:
You guys! This is just grass!
I'll burn it from the side!
text_en:
Guys! That’s just grass, 
I’ll burn it away!

text_ja: オーブ見っけ！
text_en_machine: I see the Orb!

text_ja: おれにかかれば　こんなもんよ！
text_en_machine: That's how it's done for me!

text_ja: あ...あつい...
text_en_machine: Hot... Hot...

text_ja: この辺りから　さらに暑くなるからな...
text_en_machine: It's going to get even hotter from here on out...
text_en: It only gets hotter from here...

text_ja:
オマエら！　絶対にマグマには落ちるなよ！
おれ以外には　命取りだからな！
text_en_machine:
You guys! Don't fall into the magma!
It's deadly to everyone but me!
text_en:
Hey, don’t fall into the magma!
Anyone but me would be toast!

text_ja: わわっ！マグマが迫ってきたよ！？
text_en_machine: Whoa! Magma's coming at us!

text_ja:
これはキケンだな...！
オマエら、急いで上に逃げるぞ！
text_en_machine:
This is dangerous..!
Guys, hurry up and run upstairs!
text_en:
This is dangerous...
Climb up quickly!

text_en_machine: Ahhhhh!!!

text_ja:
くそっ...　噴石だ！
巻き込まれる前に　先へ進むぞ！
text_en_machine: Damn... it's a volcanic rock! Let's move forward before we get caught in it!
text_en:
Rockfall...! Let’s move 
before we get crushed!

text_ja: ほんとに　燃えちゃうよぉ～～！！
text_en_machine: I'm really going to burn up!!

text_ja: <size=24>はしりぬけろーっっ！！</size>
text_en_machine: <size=24>Run through it!!</size>
text_fr:
テキストサイズが大きすぎるため、枠からはみ出ています。
調整をお願いします。

text_ja:
火山の頂上まで　やってきたけど、
何もない...？
text_en_machine: We've made it to the top of the volcano, but there's nothing here...?
text_en:
We made it to the volcano’s peak...
but... there’s nothing here?

text_ja:
気をつけろッ！
おれたちの　足元だっ！！
text_en_machine: Watch out! Right beneath us!!
text_en:
Watch out!
The ground beneath us!

text_ja: うわぁあっ！！
text_en_machine: Whoa!!

text_ja:
おれは何度も　コイツと戦って、
毎回...！
text_en_machine: I've fought this guy many times, and every time...!
text_en:
I’ve fought this thing so many times...
and every time...!

text_ja:
共に戦う　仲間ができた今なら、
あなたたちは　勝てるはずだと　信じていますよ。
text_en_machine: Now that we have comrades fighting alongside us, I believe you can win.
text_en:
Now that you have friends 
by your side, I truly believe 
you can do it!

text_en_machine: We did it...

text_ja: やった......！　ついに勝ったぞ！！
text_en_machine: Yes...! We finally won!

text_ja:
オイラたちみんなで
力をあわせた　おかげだねっ！
text_en_machine: Thanks to all of us working together!
text_en: Thanks to all of us working together!

text_ja:
このあたりには　非常に頑丈な
岩石質のターボンが　分布しているようです。
text_en_machine: There seems to be a distribution of very sturdy rock-like Tabons around here.
text_en:
Around here, you'll find some 
really hard, rock-like Tabons.

text_ja:
おれはソイツの親玉に負けたんだ！
次こそ倒してやる！！
text_en_machine: I lost to its leader! Next time, I'll take it down!!
text_en:
I lost to their boss last time... 
but this time, I'm gonna beat 
him for sure!

text_ja:
それは　オーブの力を奪っている可能性も
ありますね。　心してかかりましょう。
text_en_machine: It might be possible that he's stealing the power of the Orbs. Let's approach with caution.
text_en:
Beware, for they may be drawing 
strength from the Orb itself.
Do not let your guard down.

text_ja:
惑星ロンガで　最も大きな活火山が
ここベリー火山です。
text_en_machine: This is Berry Volcano, the largest active volcano on the Planet Longa.
text_en:
Here stands Berry Volcano.
The largest active volcano 
on the Planet Longa.

text_ja:
先に進むには　この山を超える必要がありますから、
くれぐれも　溶岩には気をつけてくださいね。
text_en_machine: To move forward, we need to cross this mountain, so please be careful of the lava!
text_en:
You must climb this volcano 
to move forward. 
Take care not to fall into the lava.

text_ja:
この海には、海底からしか　上陸できない
ヒミツの島が　あるんだ。
text_en_machine: There's a secret island that can only be accessed from the seabed.
text_en:
There’s a secret island you can 
only reach from below the waves.

text_ja: オーブはきっと　そこに隠されているはずだ！
text_en_machine: The Orb must be hidden there!
text_en: The Orb must be hidden there!

text_ja:
うわっ！
トゲトゲのターボンがいる...
text_en_machine: Whoa! There are spiky Tabons...
text_en:
Whoa! 
There’s a spiky Tabon here...

text_ja:
こいつらは　踏んでも倒せないんだ。
気を付けてくれ！
text_en_machine: You can't defeat these by stepping on them. Be careful!
text_en:
You can't defeat them by 
stepping on them. 
Watch your step!

text_ja:
あっ、ビリビリだ...      
キューマくんは　ビリビリだいじょうぶ？
text_en_machine: Ah, it's electric... Are you okay, Kyuma?
text_en:
Ah, it's buzzing with electricity... 
Kyuma, are you alright with that?

text_ja:
.........
できれば近づかないようにしてくれ。
text_en_machine:
...
Please stay away if possible.

text_ja:
ははーッ！！水の中のヤツは　電気がニガテなんだな！
覚えておいてやるぜ！！
text_en_machine: Haha! The ones in the water are weak against electricity! I'll remember that!!
text_en:
Ha! Creatures in water hate electricity!
I’ll remember that!

text_ja: わわっ！！水面を動かしちゃった！！
text_en_machine: Whoa!! I disturbed the water surface!!
text_en:
Whoa!! 
I moved the water surface!

text_ja:
水を自由自在に操る......
これこそが　俺の必殺ワザだ！
text_en_machine: I can manipulate water freely... This is my special move!
text_en:
Controlling water freely...
This is my special move!

text_ja: 一個目のオーブ、ゲットだ。
text_en_machine: Got the first Orb!

text_ja: この調子で　残りのオーブも集めていくぞ！
text_en_machine: Let's keep collecting the rest like this!
text_en: Let’s keep this up and find the rest!

text_ja: ここからは　フロート島の内部だ。
text_en_machine: From here we enter the interior of Float Isle
text_en:
From here on,
we’re inside Float Isle.

text_ja:
最上部まで　水で満たされているらしいが、
実は俺も　そこまでは行ったことがないんだ。
text_en_machine: Apparently it's filled with water up to the top, but I've never actually been that far.
text_en:
They say it’s flooded to the top.
But I’ve never been up there.

text_ja:
ずっと水中なんだ...　ソラコくんとリュトロンくんは
気を付けないと　いけないね......
text_en_machine: It's all underwater... Soraco and Rythron need to be careful...
text_en:
It’s all underwater here...
Soraco and Rythron must watch out.

text_ja:
あそこに　砂の壁があるけど......
水の中だから　オイラ壊せないや...
text_en_machine: There's a sand wall over there, but since it's underwater, I can't break it...
text_en:
There’s a sand wall ahead...
but underwater I can’t break it.

text_ja:
キューマくんの必殺ワザで、
水位を下げてもらったら　いいかも？
text_en_machine: Maybe Kyuma's special move can lower the water level?
text_en:
Maybe Kyuma’s Special Move...
can lower the water level?

text_ja: たしかに......！キューマくん、おねがいっ！
text_en_machine: That's right...! Kyuma, please!

text_ja:
わーい通れた！
キューマくん　ありがとう～っ！
text_en_machine: Yay, we can pass through! Thank you, Kyuma!
text_en:
Yay, we made it through!
Thanks, Kyuma!

text_ja:
...こっちの床は　リュトロンくんの炎で
燃やせそうだね！
text_en_machine: ...The floor over here looks like it can be burned by Rythron's flames!
text_en:
...Looks like Rythron’s flame
can burn this floor!

text_ja:
俺が水位を下げる。
リュトロンはその間に　床を燃やしてくれ！
text_en_machine: I'll lower the water level. Rythron, burn the floor in the meantime!
text_en:
I’ll lower the water level.
Rythron, burn the floor then!

text_ja:
は！？　なんで　おれがおまえに
指図されないと　いけないんだよッ！
text_en_machine: What?! Why should I have to take orders from you?
text_en:
Huh?! Why do I have to
take orders from you?!

text_ja: まあまあ......
text_en_machine: Come on...

text_ja:
まっ　おれがいれば
こんなの　ヨユーだぜ！
text_en_machine: Well, with me around, this is a piece of cake!
text_en:
Phew. With me here,
this is a piece of cake!

text_ja: ふたりとも、いいチームワークだったね！
text_en_machine: You two made a great team!

text_ja:
ふたりって......！　おれはべつに
協力してやろうとか　思ってねえし！！
text_en_machine: You two...! I don't have any intention of helping you or anything!
text_en:
You two...!
I didn’t do it to help you!!

text_ja:
リュトロンくんって......
いがいと　素直なんだね......
text_en_machine: Rythron is surprisingly honest...

text_ja:
はあッ！？べつにコイツに頼られたからって
うれしいとか　全然　思ってねえし！
text_en_machine: Huh?! I'm not happy at all that he asked me for help!
text_en:
Hah!? It’s not like I was
happy to be relied on, okay?!

text_ja:
このあたり、
なんだかすごく入り組んでるね......
text_en_machine: This area is really complicated...
text_en:
This place is super twisty,
like a maze...

text_ja:
そうだね......
道に迷わないよう　慎重に進もう！
text_en_machine: That's right... Let's proceed cautiously so we don't get lost!
text_en:
That’s right...
let’s be careful not to get lost!

text_ja:
わぁ......
すごい水の流れだね......！
text_en_machine: Wow... What a strong current of water...!
text_en:
Wow... that current is
really strong...

text_ja:
噂では　この先にフロート島に上陸する
出口があるらしい。　......さあ、いくぞっ！
text_en_machine: Rumor has it there's an exit to Float Isle ahead. ...Alright, let's go!
text_en:
They say there’s an exit ahead
to step onto Float Isle. Let’s go!

text_ja: うわぁっ、　いい眺めだね～！！
text_en_machine: Whoa, what a great view!!

text_ja: これが　島の上の景色なのか......！
text_en_machine: Is this what the scenery above the island looks like...?
text_en: So this is the top of the isle...

text_ja: きれいな　そら......
text_en_machine: What a beautiful sky...

text_ja:
ボクは　みんなと一緒に
冒険できないけど......
text_en_machine: I can't go on an adventure with you, but...
text_en: I can't go on adventures with you, but...

text_ja:
きっと　この世界を救ってくれるって
しんじてるよ。
text_en_machine: I believe you'll surely save this world.
text_en: I believe you’ll save this world.

text_ja:
こんな世界が　いつまでも続いたら
いいのになぁ.......　あっ！
text_en_machine: I wish this world could last forever... Oh!
text_en:
I wish this world could
stay like this forever... Ah!

text_ja: よいしょっと......
text_en_machine: Alright...

みんな、初めまして！　ボクの　名前は
「タソガレ」　って　いうんだ。
text_en_machine: Everyone, nice to meet you! My name is Tasogare.
text_en:
Hello everyone.
My name is Tasogare.

text_ja:
タソガレくん！
初めまして！
text_en_machine: Tasogare-kun! Nice to meet you!

text_ja: じつは　みんなに　渡したいものが　あるんだ。
text_en_machine: Actually, I have something to give everyone.

text_ja: これ、受け取って......
text_en_machine: Here, take this...

text_ja:
フィズたちは、タソガレから
「<color=#FF3333FF>あけとくれのしずく</color>」を受け取った！
text_en_machine: Fiz and the others received a <color=#FF3333FF>Drops of Dawn and Dusk</color> from Tasogare!
text_en:
Fiz and friends received
<color=#FF3333FF>Drops of Dawn and Dusk</color> from Tasogare!

text_en_machine: this is...?

text_ja:
このしずくは　少しでも長く
旅を続けるための　おまもりだよ。
text_en_machine: These droplets are blessings to support the journey for as long as possible.
text_en:
This Drop protects you
so your adventure lasts longer.

text_ja: 「あけとくれのしずく」を持っているとね......
text_en_machine: When you have ""Drops of Dawn and Dusk""...
text_en:
When you have the 
Drops of Dawn and Dusk...

text_ja:
もう　やられちゃうっ！って時、いちどだけ
耐えられるだけの　パワーがわくんだ。
text_en_machine: If you're about to be defeated, they will give you enough power to endure once.
text_en:
If you’re about to be knocked out,
the Drop lets you stand once more.

text_ja:
でも、だからって
無理はしちゃだめだよ。
text_en_machine: But that doesn't mean you should push yourself too hard.
text_en: But don’t push yourself too far.

text_ja:
......
タソガレくんに　話は聞いているよ。
text_en_machine: ...Tasogare-kun has told me about you.
text_en:
......
I heard about you from Tasogare.

ワタシの名前はアカツキ。
彼とワタシは　双子のドラゴンなの。
text_en_machine: My name is Akatsuki. He and I are twin dragons.
text_en:
My name is Akatsuki.
He and I are twin dragons.

text_ja:
ワタシもみんなのこと、応援してるよ。
頑張ってね。
text_en_machine: I'm cheering for all of you too. Do your best.
text_en:
I’m cheering you on too!
You’ve got this!

text_ja: きれいな　そら......
text_en_machine: What a beautiful sky...

text_ja:
ワタシは　みんなと一緒に
冒険できないけど......
text_en_machine: I can't go on an adventure with you, but...
text_en: I can’t adventure with you but...

きっと　この世界を救ってくれるって
しんじてるよ。
text_en_machine: I believe you'll surely save this world.
text_en: I believe you’ll save this world.

text_ja:
こんな世界が　いつまでも続いたら
いいのになぁ.......　あっ！
text_en_machine: I wish this world could last forever... Oh!
text_en:
I wish this world could
stay like this forever... Ah!

text_en_machine: Alright...

みんな、初めまして。　ワタシの　名前は
「アカツキ」　って　いうの。
text_en_machine: Everyone, nice to meet you. My name is Akatsuki.
text_en:
Hello everyone.
My name is Akatsuki.

text_ja:
アカツキちゃん！
初めまして！
text_en_machine: Akatsuki-chan! Nice to meet you!

text_ja: じつは　みんなに　渡したいものが　あるの。
text_en_machine: Actually, I have something to give to you.

text_ja: これ、受け取って......
text_en_machine: Here, take this...

text_ja:
フィズたちは、アカツキから
「<color=#FF3333FF>あけとくれのしずく</color>」を受け取った！
text_en_machine: Fiz and the others received the <color=#FF3333FF>Drops of Dawn and Dusk</color> from Akatsuki!
text_en:
Fiz and friends received
<color=#FF3333FF>Drops of Dawn and Dusk</color> from Akatsuki!

text_en_machine: this is...?

text_ja:
このしずくは　少しでも長く
旅を続けるための　おまもり。
text_en_machine: These droplets are blessings to support the journey for as long as possible.
text_en:
This drop is a charm
to extend your journey.

text_ja: 「あけとくれのしずく」を持っているとね......
text_en_machine: When you have ""Drops of Dawn and Dusk""...
text_en:
When you have the 
Drops of Dawn and Dusk...

text_ja:
もう　やられちゃうっ！って時、いちどだけ
耐えられるだけの　パワーがわくの。
text_en_machine: If you're about to be defeated, they will give you enough power to endure once.
text_en:
With this drop, you’ll gain power 
to survive one final hit.

text_ja:
でも、だからって
無理はしちゃだめだよ。
text_en_machine: But that doesn't mean you should push yourself too hard.
text_en: But don’t push yourself too far.

text_ja:
あ......！
アカツキちゃんに　話は聞いてるよ。
text_en_machine: Ah...! I've heard about Akatsuki-chan.
text_en:
Oh...!
Akatsuki told me about you.

text_ja:
ボクの名前はタソガレ。...アカツキちゃんと
ボクは　双子のドラゴンなんだ！
text_en_machine: My name is Tasogare. ...Akatsuki-chan and I are twin dragons!
text_en:
My name is Tasogare.
Akatsuki and I are twins!

text_ja:
ボクもみんなのこと、応援してるよ。
頑張ってね！
text_en_machine: I'm cheering for all of you too. Do your best!
text_en:
I’m cheering for you all too.
Do your best!

text_ja:
それにしても　高いところまで来たな......     
穴に落ちないように　気をつけろよ！
text_en_machine: Still, we've come up high... Be careful not to fall into any holes!
text_en:
We’ve come pretty high...
be careful not to fall in!

text_ja: この先キケン！　サメ出没注意
text_en_machine:
Warning ahead: Danger!
Beware of shark sightings.

text_ja: あれっ......　オーブはどこ？
text_en_machine: Huh...? Where's the Orb?

text_ja:
クク.....　残念だったな！
オーブの力は　このオレが頂く！
text_en_machine: Hehe... Too bad for you! The power of the Orb will be taken by me!
text_en:
Heh... too bad for you!
I’ll take the Orbs’ power!

text_ja: 誰だっ！！？
text_en_machine: Who are you!!?
Hehehe...

text_ja:
今から食べる　メシに向かって
自己紹介するような　ヤツなんざ......
text_en_machine: There's no one who would introduce themselves before eating their meal like this......
text_en:
Who introduces themselves
to the meal they’re about to eat?

text_ja: <size=24>いねえだろっ！！</size>
text_en_machine: <size=24>There's no way!! </size>

text_ja:
出てこいっ！
今度こそ　オーブを返してもらうぞ！
text_en_machine: Come out! This time, I'm getting my Orb back!
text_en:
Show yourself!
This time you’ll give us 
the Orb back!

text_ja:
おいおい！
また食べられに来たのか？
text_en_machine: Hey, hey! Are you here again to get eaten?
text_en:
Well, well! 
Came back just to be someone’s meal?

text_en_machine: Hehehe...

text_ja: 何度でも　相手してやるぜッ！
text_en_machine: I'll fight you again and again!
text_en: I’ll face you again and again!

text_ja:
うわーっ！
オイラたち　食べられちゃうよ！！
text_en_machine: Whoa!! We're going to get eaten!!

text_ja:
相手の動きをよく見て、
攻撃を避けるのです......！
text_en_machine: Watch your opponent's movements and avoid their attacks...!
text_en:
Watch his moves closely,
and dodge every strike!

text_ja: うぎゃあっ！！？
text_en_machine: Aaahh!!!
I've had enough...

text_ja:
お......おい！　「まいった」って言ってるだろ！
オレの負けだ！
text_en_machine: Hey! I'm saying I've had enough! I admit defeat!
text_en:
Hey... I said I’ve lost!
I admit defeat!

text_ja:
わかった！　わかったから！
いい加減　やめてくれ......ッ！
text_en_machine:
Okay! I get it!
Stop it already...!
text_en:
Okay! I get it!
Just stop already...!

text_ja:
いつまで　やるつもりなんだ？！
もう　何も出てこねえって！
text_en_machine:
How long are you going to keep doing this?
Nothing more will come out!
text_en:
How long will you do this?!
There’s nothing left to come out!

text_ja: オーブを取り戻したぞ！
text_en_machine: We got the Orb back!

text_ja:
これで　フロート島のオーブは
すべて守られました。
text_en_machine: With this, all of Float Isle's Orbs have been protected.
text_en:
Now all Float Isle Orbs
are safe.

text_ja:
次はいよいよ　最後の仲間がいる場所です。
気を引き締めなおして　臨むのですよ。
text_en_machine:
Up next we finally arrive at the location where our last companions are.
We need to gear up and get ready.
text_en:
Next is where our final ally awaits.
Brace yourselves!

text_ja: くっ...!こいつら...！
text_en_machine: Damn...! These guys...!

text_ja: なら　これならどうだァ！
text_en_machine: Then, how about this?!

text_ja:
フロート島の奥地は　凶暴な
魚人の縄張りに　なっているようです。
text_en_machine: The depths of Float Isle seem to be the territory of the ferocious fishermen.
text_en:
Deep within Float Isle lies
a territory of ruthless fisherman.

text_ja:
凶暴な魚人...か。　もしも先にオーブを
奪われていたら　厄介かもな。
text_en_machine: The ferocious fisherman... If they've taken the Orb before us, it could be troublesome.
text_en:
Ruthless fisherman...
If they’d taken the Orb first,
we’d be in serious trouble.

text_ja:
ええ。世界を守る力を得るには
オーブを取り返さなければ　なりません。
text_en_machine: Yes. To gain the power to protect the world, we must retrieve the Orb.
text_en:
Correct. We must reclaim the Orbs
to gain the power required
to defend our world.

text_ja:
この海にある、
断崖絶壁に囲まれた島......
text_en_machine: This island in the sea is surrounded by steep cliffs...
text_en:
An island rises from the sea,
surrounded by towering cliffs...

text_ja:
まるで　浮いているように見えることから、
フロート島と名付けられました。
text_en_machine: Because it looks like it's floating, it was named Float Isle.
text_en:
It seems to drift above waves,
so it’s called Float Isle.

text_ja:
フロート島に　上陸するためには、
海底洞窟を　通らねばならないようです。
text_en_machine: To land on Float Isle, we must pass through the underwater cave.
text_en:
To land there safely,
we must pass through sea caves.

text_ja:
この街には　ほかの地域では見られないような
おもしろいモノが　たくさんあるわ。
text_en_machine: This town has a lot of interesting things that can't be found in other regions.
text_en:
This town’s full of curiosities
you won’t find elsewhere.

text_ja:
オーブ探しを進めながら、
たくさん　楽しんじゃいましょう！
text_en_machine: Let's have lots of fun while we continue searching for the Orb!
text_en:
Let’s hunt Orbs
and have lots of fun!

text_ja: こんばんはっ！
text_en_machine: Good evening!

text_ja:
おや...　このあたりに　ドラゴンのこどもが
来るなんて　珍しいねぇ......
text_en_machine: Oh... It's rare for dragon cub to come around here...
text_en:
Oh? A baby dragon here?
That’s a rare sight...

text_ja:
この先を　進んでいくなら、
気をつけたほうがいいよ。
text_en_machine: If you're going to proceed ahead, you should be careful.
text_en:
If you go further,
you’d best be careful.

text_ja:
なんてったって、　ぼくたちスライムは
小さなドラゴンを見るとすぐ...
text_en_machine: After all, we slimes, when we see a small dragon, we immediately...
text_en:
You see, we slimes,
when we spot baby dragons...

text_ja: すぐ？
text_en_machine: Immediately?

text_ja: <size=24>パクッ！</size>...っと食べちゃうからね
text_en_machine: <size=24>Crack! </size>... I'm going to eat you up!

text_ja: ひいっ！
text_en_machine: Noooooo!

text_ja:
うふふ！　ぼくはたった一人の
食べない派スライムだから　安心してよっ。
text_en_machine: Uhehe! I'm the only slime who doesn't eat, so you can relax.
text_en:
Hehe! I’m the only slime
who doesn’t eat dragons.
You can relax!

text_ja: （安心できるか！）
text_en_machine: (Can we rest assured?!)

text_ja:
わっわっ！
このあたり、毒の水に　囲まれてるよ～！
text_en_machine: Wow! This area is surrounded by poisonous water!
text_en:
Whoa! This area is surrounded
by poison water!

text_ja: 何とかして　水を抜かなきゃ......
text_en_machine: We have to find a way to drain the water...
text_en: We’ve gotta drain this water somehow...

text_ja: ここは　わたしに任せて！
text_en_machine: Leave this to me!

text_ja:
実は　毒に耐性があるの。
わたしが泳いで　先を見てくる！
text_en_machine: Actually, I have a resistance to poison. I'll swim ahead and take a look!
text_en:
Actually, I’m poison-resistant.
I'll swim ahead and take a look!

text_ja: うわぁッ！！！！
text_en_machine: Whoa!!

text_ja:
なんだか　地面が揺れているけど
ここは一体......？
text_en_machine: The ground is shaking, but what on earth is this...?
text_en:
The ground’s shaking...
Where on earth are we?

text_ja:
......わわっ！
オイラたち、電車の上に落ちてきちゃった！？
text_en_machine: Wow! Did we just fall onto a train!?
text_en:
Whoa!
We’ve landed on a train!?

text_ja:
どうやら　街の中心部に向かう列車に
乗ったみたいね...。
text_en_machine: It seems we've boarded a train heading to the city center...
text_en:
Looks like we boarded the train
heading for the city center...

text_ja:
ちょうどいいから、このまま車内を探索しながら
終点に着くのを　待ちましょう！
text_en_machine: Since we're here, let's explore the inside of the train while we wait to reach the final stop!
text_en:
Perfect, let’s explore the carriages
while we wait for the last stop.

text_ja: え？　なにこれは
text_en_machine: Huh? What is this?

text_ja:
これは......
「グリーン車」　ってやつね！
text_en_machine: This is... the ""Green Car""!

text_ja:
......
だまされないぞ　オレは！
text_en_machine: I'm not falling for that!

text_ja:
ありがとう......僕はこの列車の車掌です。
皆さんのおかげで　助かりました！
text_en_machine: Thank you... I'm the conductor of this train. Thanks to all of you, I was saved!
text_en:
Thank you... I’m the conductor.
You all saved me!

text_ja: どういたしまして！
text_en_machine: You're welcome!

text_ja:
列車はまもなく　終着駅に到着します。
お気をつけて　行ってらっしゃい！
text_en_machine:
The train will arrive at the last station soon.
Have a safe trip!
text_en:
Final station is just ahead.
Have a safe trip!

text_ja:
そういえば　すごいヘンな乗り方を
しちゃったけど　怒られないかな...？
text_en_machine:
Oh, by the way... I did something really weird.
I wonder if they'll be mad at me...?
text_en:
So... that was a pretty strange 
way to board. I hope they
won’t kick us out...

text_ja:
心配しないで！
乗り放題パス　持ってるから！
text_en_machine:
Don't worry!
I have an unlimited ride pass!
text_en:
Don’t worry!
I’ve got an unlimited ride pass!

text_ja:
さすが　この街に住んでるだけあって
用意周到だな！
text_en_machine: As expected from someone who lives in this town, you're well-prepared!
text_en:
Of course you do, 
you’re a hometown pro!

text_ja: いや　だめなのかよ！！
text_en_machine: No, that's not okay!!

text_ja:
ついに　この星のオーブをすべて集め、
世界を守るために　必要な仲間が揃いました。
text_en_machine: Finally, we've collected all the Orbs on this planet and gathered the necessary companions to protect the world.
text_en:
Finally, we've gathered every 
Orb, and our team is complete 
to save the world.

text_ja:
そんなこと　許せねえ！
月でもなんでも　行ってやるぜ！！
text_en_machine: I won't allow that! I'll go to the moon or wherever!!
text_en:
I won’t stand for this!  
If I have to, I’ll go to the moon!!

text_ja: 心強い反応、安心しました。
text_en_machine: I'm relieved by your strong response.

text_ja:
しかし、私たちにはまだ
やることが　残っています。
text_en_machine: However, we still have things left to do.
text_en: However, there’s still work to be done.

text_ja: 「やること」って？
text_en_machine: What do you mean by ""things""?

text_ja: 空を見上げてください。
text_en_machine: Look up at the sky.

text_ja: 今日は　月が良く見えるわね。
text_en_machine: The moon looks good today.

text_ja:
実は　この惑星ロンガと同じように、
月にも　オーブが存在しています。
text_en_machine: Actually, just like on the Planet Longa, there are Orbs on the moon as well.
text_en:
It seems waning because
the moon Orb’s power has faded...

text_ja:
あのような　欠けた姿に見えるのは、
月のオーブの力が　弱まったから......
text_en_machine: The reason it looks like that with those missing pieces is that the power of the moon's Orbs has weakened...
text_en:
The reason it looks like that with those
missing pieces is that the power of the
moon's Orbs has weakened...

text_ja:
そ...そうなのっ！？
どうして　そんなことになっちゃったの？
text_en_machine: R-Really!? How did that happen?
text_en:
Re... really?!
How could that happen?!

text_ja:
星の色彩と力を　奪おうとする勢力が、
月を拠点にして　拡大を続けているのです。
text_en_machine: A force trying to steal the colors and power of the stars has been expanding its reach from the moon as its base.
text_en:
A force seeking to steal
our world’s color and power
is using the moon as its base.

text_ja: 既に私だけでは　手に負えないほどに...
text_en_machine: It's already beyond what I can handle alone...
text_en:
Their spread only continues.
It has already become too great 
for me to handle alone...

text_en_machine: However...

text_ja:
月へ向かう　ここから先の道のりは
今までよりも　過酷なものになるでしょう。
text_en_machine: The journey ahead toward the moon will be harsher than before.
text_en:
The path to the moon will be tougher  
than anything you’ve faced so far.

text_ja:
あなたたちが　これまでの冒険を通して
試練を乗り越えうるほどに　成長できたのか？
text_en_machine: Have you all grown enough through your adventures to overcome these trials?
text_en:
Have you grown enough  
on your journey to meet the challenge?

text_ja:
今　この場所で、
私に確かめさせてください。
text_en_machine: Now, here in this place, please let me confirm that.
text_en: Here and now, let me test you.

text_ja: 信じていますよ。
text_en_machine: I believe you.

...!
To think it would come to this...!

text_ja:
あなたたちなら　きっと、
どんな道でも　乗り越えてゆけるでしょう......
text_en_machine: I'm sure you can overcome any challenge...
text_en:
If it’s you, I’m sure  
you can overcome 
any challenge...

text_ja:
......さあ！
最後の冒険へ　出発しましょう！
text_en_machine: ...Now! Let's set off on our final adventure!
text_en:
...Now! Let’s set off 
on the final adventure!

text_ja:
あなたたちなら　きっと戻ってくるだろうと
信じていましたよ。
text_en_machine: I believed that you would surely come back.
text_en:
I knew you’d return;
I’ve always believed in you.

text_ja:
さて......
準備は良いですか？
text_en_machine: Now... Are you ready?

text_ja: 始めましょう。
text_en_machine: Let's begin.
... What was that!?

text_ja:
でっかいネオンサインが　うごいてる！
もしかして　オーブのせいなのかな......？
text_en_machine: A huge neon sign is moving! Could it be because of the Orb...?
text_en:
A giant neon sign is moving!
Is it because of the Orb...?

text_ja:
ええ......。　 おそらく　オーブの力で
モノが意思を持ち　動き出したのでしょう。
text_en_machine: Yes... It's likely that it gained consciousness and started moving due to the power of the Orb.
text_en:
Indeed... It is likely that the 
Orb's power granted will and 
motion to lifeless things.

text_ja:
ネオンサインということは、電気か！
感電に　気を付けたいところだな......。
text_en_machine: Since it's a neon sign, it must be electricity! We need to be careful not to get electrocuted...
text_en:
A neon sign means electricity!
Better watch out for getting zapped...

text_ja: オーブを取り返したわよ！
text_en_machine: I got the Orb back!

text_ja:
やった！　これでやっと
この街のオーブが　そろったね！
text_en_machine:
We did it!　Finally!
We finally have all the orbs in this town!
text_en:
We did it! Now finally,
this town’s Orbs are all here!

text_ja:
この都市では近年、ネオン看板のような
謎の生物が　確認されているようです。
text_en_machine: In this city, mysterious creatures resembling neon signs have been confirmed in recent years.
text_en:
In recent years, Candy Polis has been 
haunted by strange neon like creatures.

text_ja:
その生物は　体を糸のように伸ばし
私たちを　電撃で麻痺させてしまうとか。
text_en_machine: These creatures stretch their bodies like threads and can paralyze us with electric shocks.
text_en:
They say these creatures can stretch 
their bodies like wires and paralyze us 
with electric shocks.

text_ja:
それは恐ろしいわね......　でも　私だって
ワイヤーを使って　攻撃できるんだから！
text_en_machine: That's terrifying... But I can attack using wires too!
text_en:
That's terrifying......　
But I can do it too.
I can attack with a wire!

text_ja:
電気の糸と　私の糸、どちらか強いか
試してやろうじゃない！
text_en_machine: Let's see whose thread is stronger, mine or the electric one!
text_en:
Let's see which is stronger.
My string or the electric one!

text_ja:
ここキャンディポリスは　惑星ロンガで最も
発展した都市として　知られています。
text_en_machine: Candypolis is known as the most developed city on the Planet Longa.
text_en:
Candy Polis is known as the most 
advanced city on Planet Longa.

text_ja:
そして　多くの生物たちが　この地で
営みを送っているのですが......
text_en_machine: Many creatures live their lives here, but...
text_en: Here, a great variety of beings dwell...

text_ja:
種族間での対立が起こることも
珍しくないようです。
text_en_machine: It's not uncommon for conflicts to arise between species.
text_en:
yet rivalries between them 
are far from rare.

text_ja:
ぼくは　準備万端だから、
いつでも　勝負できるよ！
text_en_machine: I'm fully prepared, so I'm ready for a challenge anytime!
text_en:
I'm all set!
Ready to battle anytime!

text_ja:
ふふ......
本気のぼくに　勝てるかな？
text_en_machine: Hehe... I wonder if you can beat me at my best?
text_en:
Hehe...
Think you can beat me for real?

text_ja:
ぼくたちは　もう少しこの星を
観光してから　帰るよ！
text_en_machine: We're going to explore this planet a bit more before heading back!
text_en:
We'll do a bit more sightseeing
before heading back!

text_ja:
見るものがたくさんあって......
本当に　楽しいところだね！
text_en_machine: There are so many things to see... It's really a fun place!
text_en:
So much to see here...
It's really fun!

text_ja: ざんねん！今回はぼくの勝ちだったね。
text_en_machine: What a pity! This time I won.
text_en: Too bad! Looks like I won this time.

text_ja: 諦めずに　また挑戦してよ！
text_en_machine: Don't give up and try again!
text_en: Don't give up, try again soon!

text_ja:
......また　負けちゃった！
きみたちやっぱり　強いね！
text_en_machine: ...I lost again! You all are really strong!

text_ja: またこんど勝負しようね！
text_en_machine: Let's have another match next time!

text_ja:
まさか　本気のぼくにも　勝っちゃうなんて！
きみたちやっぱり　強いね！
text_en_machine: I can't believe you beat my serious self! You all are really strong!
text_en:
No way! You even beat me
at full power... You're amazing!

text_ja: 助かった......
text_en_machine: Thank goodness...

text_ja: プレーンくん、　おまたせ～！
text_en_machine: Hey, Plain-kun, sorry to keep you waiting!
text_en: Hey, Plain! Sorry to keep you!

text_ja:
ああ、リアリーちゃん！
ちょうどいいところに！
text_en_machine: Ah, Leary-chan! Just in time!

text_ja: プレーンくんの　お友達？
text_en_machine: Are you Plane's friend? Oh? Could it be...

text_ja: あら？　そこにいるのは　もしかして......
text_en_machine: Oh? Could it be...

text_ja:
プレーンくんから　話は聞いているわ！
私はリアリー。　よろしくね。
text_en_machine:
I've heard about you from Plain!
I'm Leary. Nice to meet you.
text_en:
Plain told me about you!
I'm Leary. Nice to meet you!

text_ja:
わぁ！
リアリーちゃん　よろしくねっ！
text_en_machine: Wow! Nice to meet you, Leary-chan!
text_en:
Wow!
Nice to meet you, Leary!

text_ja:
そうだ！　リアリーちゃんも
フィズくんたちと　勝負してみたら？
text_en_machine: Oh right! Leary-chan should try battling with Fiz and the others too!
text_en:
Hey, Leary! Why don't you
try battling Fiz and friends?

text_en_machine: Huh!?

text_ja:
私は　遠慮しておくわ。
理由もなく勝負なんて　しないわよ。
text_en_machine:
I'll pass.
I don't compete for no reason.
text_en:
I’ll pass.
I don’t fight without a reason.

text_ja: ここのケーキ、おいしかったなあ......
text_en_machine: The cake here was delicious. ......
text_en: That cake here... was so good...

text_ja:
道に迷ったけど　結果的に
フィズくんたちに会えて　よかったよ！
text_en_machine: I got lost, but in the end, I'm glad I met Fiz and the others!
text_en:
I got lost, but in the end,
I'm glad I ran into you!

text_ja: プレーンくん　久しぶり！
text_en_machine: Mr. Plain, it's been a long time!

text_ja:
あっ、また会ったね！
...どうにか　この店にたどり着いたよ！
text_en_machine:
Ah, we meet again!
... Somehow I made it to this restaurant!
text_en:
Ah, we meet again!
I finally made it to this shop!

text_ja:
なんか......　
甘くて　おいしそうな香りがするぜ！
text_en_machine: It smells sweet and delicious!
text_en:
Mmm...
Something smells sweet and tasty!

text_ja:
そうそう！　ぼく、ちょうど今
ケーキを　食べたところだったんだけど...
text_en_machine: That's right! I just finished eating cake...
text_en:
Oh yeah!
I just had some cake...

text_ja:
すごく美味しくて
みるみる力が　湧いてきたよ！
text_en_machine: It was so delicious that I felt my strength returning quickly!
text_en:
It was so good,
I feel totally recharged!

text_ja:
いまは　人を待っていてヒマだから、
強くなったボクと　力試ししてみない？
text_en_machine: Right now, I'm waiting for someone and I'm bored, so how about testing your strength against me?
text_en:
I'm waiting for someone now...
Wanna test your strength on me?

text_ja:
力試しか......
のぞむところだ！
text_en_machine: A strength test... I'm all for it!
text_en:
A challenge, huh...?
I’m all in!

text_ja:
よしっ！　それじゃあここだと狭いから、
隣の部屋で　勝負だ！
text_en_machine: Alright then! Since it's cramped here, let's battle in the next room!
text_en:
Alright then!
Let’s fight in the next room!

text_ja:
ふふ......
本気のぼくに　勝てるかな？
text_en_machine: Hehe... I wonder if you can beat my serious self?
text_en:
Hehe...
Think you can beat me for real?

text_ja:
うわあああああ！！！
雲の上を　飛んでる！！
text_en_machine:
Aaahhh!
We're flying above the clouds!
text_en:
Whaaaaa!!!
We're flying above the clouds!

text_en_machine: This is so much fun!!!

text_ja:
皆さん......　くれぐれも
落ちないように　気を付けてくださいね。
text_en_machine: Everyone... please be careful not to fall.
text_en:
Everyone...
Please be careful not to fall.

text_ja:
きゃあ！　あれ、葉っぱの上で
リーファーたちを　襲ってきたヤツだよ！
text_en_machine: Geez! That's the one that attacked Leafur on the leaves!
text_en:
Eek! That’s the thing
that attacked Leafur at the leaf!

text_ja:
ううっ......！
こんなとこまで　追ってくるなんて！
text_en_machine: Ugh... To think it would follow us all the way here!
text_en:
Ugh...
It chased us all the way here!?

text_ja:
さあ！                    
一気に宇宙へ　飛び立ちますよ！
text_en_machine: Alright! We're taking off into space now!
text_en:
Okay, time to blast off
into space together!

text_ja:
<color=#FF9999FF>私の背中</color>に、
しっかりと　掴まっていてくださいね。
text_en_machine: <color=#FF9999FF>Hold on tight to my back</color>.
text_en:
Hold on tight
<color=#FF9999FF>to my back</color>, please!

text_ja: これが　月のオーブ...！
text_en_machine: This is the Orb of the Moon...!

text_ja: うわあっ！　地面が　まわっちゃった！？
text_en_machine: Whoa! The ground is spinning!?

text_ja:
今の月はまさに　未知の世界。
何が起こるのか　全く予想できませんね......。
text_en_machine: Right now, the moon is truly an unknown world. We can't predict at all what will happen...
text_en:
This moon has become
a land of the unknown.
No one can foresee what lies ahead...

text_ja:
上等だ！　どんなことが起きようが、
オレたちで　乗り越えてやろうぜ！
text_en_machine: Bring it on! No matter what happens, we'll overcome it together!
text_en:
Bring it on! No matter what happens,
we'll overcome it together!

text_ja: 7-2オーブ発見用セリフ
text_en_machine: 7-2 lines for finding orbs

text_ja:
......
空気が　かわったね......
text_en_machine: ... The air has changed...

text_ja:
そう、
ここは　すでに　敵の拠点内。
text_en_machine:
Yes,
we're already inside the enemy base.
text_en:
Yes...
We’ve already stepped 
into enemy ground.

text_ja:
もし　一人で乗り込めば
すぐに　力を奪われて　しまうことでしょう......
text_en_machine: If you go in alone, you'll soon have your power stolen...
text_en:
If you go in alone,
your power will be stolen instantly...

text_ja:
なんてこと......
でも、いまは　わたしたちがいるわ！
text_en_machine:
Oh dear...
But now we have it!
text_en:
That’s awful...
But we’re all here now!

text_ja:
そうだよ！　ぼくたちみんなが
力を合わせれば　きっと大丈夫！
text_en_machine: That's right! If we all work together, we’ll surely be fine!
text_en:
Yeah!
Together, we’ll be just fine!

text_en_machine: Something is... coming...!

text_ja:
ついに　月の勢力のボスが
姿を　現しましたか......。
text_en_machine: The boss of the moon forces has finally appeared...
text_en:
So... the boss of the moon's forces
finally shows his face...

text_ja:
奴の放つ光は　色彩を奪い去る
恐ろしい力を　秘めています。
text_en_machine: The light it emits holds a terrifying power that steals colors.
text_en:
That light... it’s terrifying.
It strips the world of its colors!

text_ja:
決して　全身に　光を浴びることなく
警戒して　好機を伺うのです！
text_en_machine: Never let your entire body be exposed to the light; stay alert and look for an opportunity!
text_en:
Never let it touch your whole body.
Stay alert... and wait for your moment.

text_ja:
全身に光を浴びないように、　<color=#FF9999FF>壁の後ろに
隠れながら</color>　進んでいけば　いいんだね！
text_en_machine:
To avoid exposing your whole body to the light, you just need to <color=#FF9999FF>hide
behind the wall</color> and proceed!
text_en:
Stay out of the light.
<color=#FF9999FF>Hide behind walls</color>
and move ahead carefully!

text_ja: いったい　何が起こってるの......？
text_en_machine: What on earth is going on...?

text_ja: わぁっ！！
text_en_machine: Wow!

text_ja:
『オリジンターボン』...　既にこれほどまで
星の色彩と力を　得ていたとは......！
text_en_machine: Origin Tabon... I can't believe he has already gained this much of the planet's colors and power...!
text_en:
Origin Tabon...
it had already absorbed so much
of the planet’s color and power...

text_ja:
おい！こいつ......
攻撃が　ぜんぜん効かねえぞ！
text_en_machine: Hey! This guy... Our attacks aren't working at all!
text_en:
Hey! This thing’s
not taking any damage!

text_ja:
力を奪われた　この場所では、　私たち
全員の力でも　敵わないと　いうのですか......
text_en_machine: In this place where our power has been stolen, are we saying that even all of us together can't defeat it...?
text_en:
In this place where power fades...
could it be that all of us together
still can’t win...?

text_ja:
いや......！　まだきっと
やっつけるチャンスは　残っているはずだよ！
text_en_machine: No...! There must still be a chance to take him down!
text_en:
No way!
There must still be a chance!

text_ja:
ねえ......
あの光は　なんなの......！？
text_en_machine: Hey... What is that light...?

text_ja: 吸い込まれる～～～！！！
text_en_machine: It's sucking me in!!

............
Ugh... What the hell is this place...?

text_ja:
おそらくここは　奴が作った　幻影の世界...
私たちを　閉じ込めるつもりなのでしょう。
text_en_machine:
Perhaps this is an illusion of his making...
where he intends to trap us.
text_en:
This world...
is likely one of illusion,
built to imprison us.

text_ja:
そんな終わり方　させるもんか！
ぜったいに抜け出して　やっつけるんだから！
text_en_machine:
I won't let it end that way!
I'm going to get out of here and finish it!
text_en:
I won't let it end that way!
I'm going to get out of here
and take him down!

text_ja: オーブの力が　わずかに戻った...？
text_en_machine: The power of the Orb has slightly returned...?
text_en:
The power of the Orb has
slightly returned...?

text_ja:
...見てください！　今の攻撃で
相手の防御が　崩れています！
text_en_machine: ...Look! The opponent's defense is breaking down from that attack!
text_en:
Look! That last hit.
His guard is down!

text_en_machine:
...!
This will definitely work...!

text_ja:
奪われていた力が　ヤツから
すべて　解放されたようです！
text_en_machine: It seems that the power that was stolen has been completely released!
text_en:
It looks like all the stolen power
has been released!

text_ja:
みんな！　あと　ひと踏ん張りだよ！
ぼくたちで　星を　まもるんだ！
text_en_machine: Everyone! Just one more push! We will protect the planet together!
text_en:
Everyone! Just a little more!
We’re the ones who’ll 
protect this world!

text_ja:
空に浮かぶ月は 「マカロンムーン」と
呼ばれています。
text_en_machine: The moon floating in the sky is called Macaron Moon.
text_en:
The moon that drifts above us
is known as the Macaron Moon.

text_ja:
これから向かう　月への旅は
非常に厳しい道のりに　なるでしょう。
text_en_machine: The journey to the moon ahead will be a very tough road.
text_en:
The road that leads to its glow
will test us every step of the way.

text_ja:
しかし、私たちの力を合わせれば
きっと　乗り越えられるはずです。
text_en_machine: However, if we combine our powers, we should surely be able to overcome it.
text_en:
But as long as we stand together,
no challenge can break our will.

text_ja: 宝箱をひらいた！
text_en_machine: I opened the treasure chest!

text_ja:
フィズたちは、宝箱の中から
「<color=#FF3333FF>つるぎのペンダント</color>」を手に入れた！
text_en_machine:
Fiz and friends found a
<color=#FF3333FF>Pendant of Blades</color> from the treasure chest!
text_en:
Fiz and friends found
a <color=#FF3333FF>Pendant of Blades</color> inside!

text_ja: わぁ！　カッコいいペンダント！
text_en_machine: Wow! Cool pendant!

text_ja:
冒険の合間に　宝探しをしてみるのも
面白いかも　しれませんね。
text_en_machine: It might be interesting to try treasure hunting during our adventures.
text_en:
Treasure hunting might be
a fun break from adventuring too.

text_ja: 大切に　とっておこうっと......
text_en_machine: I'll cherish this and keep it safe...
text_en: I’m gonna keep this one safe...

text_ja: 宝箱をひらいた！
text_en_machine: I opened the treasure chest!

text_ja:
フィズたちは、宝箱の中から
「<color=#FF3333FF>つりざお</color>」を手に入れた！
text_en_machine:
Fiz and friends found a
<color=#FF3333FF>Fishing Rod</color> from the treasure chest!
text_en:
Fiz and friends found
a <color=#FF3333FF>Fishing Rod</color> inside!

text_ja: なんで　つりざおが　こんな所に......？
text_en_machine: Why is your slingshot here ......?
text_en:
Why is there a fishing rod
in a place like this...?

text_ja:
うわー！　いっぱいつれそうな　つりざお！！
あとで　つかっちゃおうっと！
text_en_machine:
Wow!　Looks like we'll have plenty of slingshots!
I'll hang on to it later!
text_en:
Whoa!
Looks like you could 
catch tons with this!

text_ja: 宝箱をひらいた！
text_en_machine: I opened the treasure chest!

text_ja:
フィズたちは、宝箱の中から
「<color=#FF3333FF>しんぴのほうせき</color>」を手に入れた！
text_en_machine:
Fiz and friends found a
<color=#FF3333FF>Mystical Gem</color> from the treasure chest!
text_en:
Fiz and friends found
a <color=#FF3333FF>Mystical Gem</color> inside!

text_ja: わあ！　何の宝石だろう！
text_en_machine: Wow! What a gem!
text_en: Wow! I wonder what kind of gem this is!

text_ja:
この地域では　有名なヤツだな！
火山のパワーが　詰まってるらしいぜ！
text_en_machine: It's famous in this area! It's said to be filled with the power of the volcano!
text_en:
That one’s famous around here.
It’s said to hold volcanic power!

text_ja: 宝箱をひらいた！
text_en_machine: I opened the treasure chest!

text_ja:
フィズたちは、宝箱の中から
「<color=#FF3333FF>おんがくディスク</color>」を手に入れた！
text_en_machine:
Fiz and friends found a
<color=#FF3333FF>Music Disk</color> from the treasure chest!
text_en:
Fiz and friends found
a <color=#FF3333FF>Music Disk</color> inside!

text_ja:
わーい！
何の曲が入ってるのかな？
text_en_machine: Wow! I wonder what songs are on it?
text_en:
Yay!
What kind of song is on it?

text_ja:
気になるわね......
あとで　聴いてみましょ！
text_en_machine: I'm curious... Let's listen to it later!
text_en:
I’m curious too...
Let’s listen later!

- look, snowy mountain!

The snowy mountain

then press ⑪ to fire the wire!

⑪ を押しっぱなしにすると、
